units.source_text: 在良平八岁那一年，小田原和热海中间开始铺设小火车轨道。

en.t: In the year when Ryohei was eight, a small railway track began to be laid between Odawara and Atami.

units.source_text: 良平天天都去村边观看这项铺路工程。

en.t: Every day, Ryohei went to the edge of the village to watch the track-laying work.

units.source_text: 所谓的工程，其实只不过是用斗车装运土方——当然良平正是对矿车装运土方这事儿很感兴趣才跑去围观的。

en.t: The so-called work was really nothing more than hauling earth in carts; of course, Ryohei had gone to watch precisely because he was fascinated by the carts carrying the earth.
